Knowledge: The supplied explanation requires pupil constriction, which is not shown. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: Anatomy and composition are coherent, but large blown-out fur areas lose natural texture and the intensely saturated eyes look unnatural; these are two clear visual flaws.
